name: CONSUL Democracy
tagline: The most complete citizen participation tool for an open, transparent and democratic government.
dependency_risks: reliance on Certified Companies for revenue
academic_citations: Baiocchi, G., & Ganuza, E. (2017). Popular democracy: The paradox of participation. Stanford University Press.
Sintomer, Y., Herzberg, C., & Röcke, A. (2016). Participatory budgeting in Europe: Democracy and public governance. Routledge.
awards: 2018 OECD Observatory of Public Sector Innovation recognition

policy_outcomes.description: Used by Decide Madrid, the participatory platform for the City of Madrid, enabling binding citizen proposals and participatory budgeting.
UNDP collaboration to develop SDG module for aligning citizen participation with Sustainable Development Goals.

outcome_methodology: Platform tracks participation metrics including number of proposals, votes cast, and citizen engagement rates; outcomes measured through government adoption rates and participatory budgeting allocations
published_performance_metrics: ~350 governments have used the platform; 'more than 250 cities and organizations' per homepage
documented_limitations: Digital divide: requires internet access and digital literacy
Varying levels of government commitment to implementing citizen proposals
Limited data on long-term behavioral change or policy impact
failure_modes: Low participation rates in some municipalities due to lack of promotion
Difficulty sustaining engagement over time without institutional support
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines under AGPLv3; code review by foundation maintainers; Certified Companies program for commercial implementations
contributor_governance: Open source under AGPLv3; Certified Companies contribute code; Foundation maintains core
disparity_tracking: Limited documented tracking; platform aims for inclusive participation but equity outcomes not systematically measured across demographics
community_ownership: Community-driven development through open source model; local government ownership of implementations; foundation stewardship of core platform
ai_involvement: No documented AI or machine learning components in core platform
